title: TurnBase Game Manifest
description: Normative schema for the manifest.json at the root of a TurnBase game bundle. Single source of truth for game metadata, capabilities, entry points, team templates, and host-configurable parameters. Realizes FR-MANIFEST-001 through FR-MANIFEST-009. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (range ordering, default-in-range, default-in-options, parameter-key uniqueness, conditional team name) are enforced as supplementary programmatic checks documented in manifest-schema.md. Unknown keys are permitted (lenient) and surfaced as non-fatal warnings by the validator.

manifestVersion.description: Schema revision of this manifest document. Currently only "1" is supported; unknown versions are rejected.

shortDescription.description: One-line summary shown in the catalog and as the info-section fallback.

version.description: Game version, x.y.z with numeric segments only (game-catalog.md FR-GAME-009).

gdkApiVersion.description: Version of the GDK API the game was built against, x.y.z (FR-GDK-016). Compatibility against platform-supported ranges is checked by the upload pipeline, not by this schema.

runtime.description: Backend runtime that determines how the backend component is interpreted (FR-BUNDLE-007). Only "jvm" is supported initially.

backend.description: Backend component descriptor. Runtime-agnostic shape: path locates the artifact in the archive; entryPoint is interpreted per runtime (for jvm, the fully qualified class implementing TurnBaseGame — FR-MANIFEST-008).

path.description: Relative path within the bundle to the backend artifact (for jvm, the fat JAR).

entryPoint.description: Runtime-interpreted entry identifier. For jvm: fully qualified class name, e.g. com.example.ChessGame.
Relative path within the bundle to the JavaScript entry file, e.g. frontend/main.js (FR-MANIFEST-009).

infoDoc.description: Optional relative path within the bundle to a Markdown info/rules document (FR-MANIFEST-007, FR-BUNDLE-005).

tags.description: 1–10 free-form tags, each 1–24 characters (FR-MANIFEST-006, game-catalog.md FR-GAME-003).

ai.description: Whether the game supports AI (bot) players.

spectators.description: Whether the game supports the spectator role.

midGameJoin.description: Whether players may join a session already in progress.

teamTemplates.description: Team templates defining the game's team structure (FR-MANIFEST-002, game-rooms.md FR-TEAM). At least one entry. When more than one entry is declared, each must declare a name (supplementary check).

parameters.description: Optional host-configurable parameters (FR-MANIFEST-004, FR-MANIFEST-005). Keys must be unique across the array (supplementary check).

range.description: Inclusive integer range. max >= min is enforced as a supplementary check.

name.description: Display name for teams of this type. Required when multiple templates are declared (supplementary check); defaults to "Team" for a single template.

parameter.description: A host-configurable parameter. Type-specific fields and cross-field rules (default within range / among options) are detailed in manifest-schema.md.

key.description: Unique identifier used by the backend GameParameters accessors.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in the lobby parameter UI.
